mapper.insert: INSERT INTO integration.if_trace_event(request_key,attempt_id,stage,outcome) SELECT id,COALESCE(CAST(#{attempt} AS uuid),CASE WHEN #{stage} IN ('RESPONSE_PROCESSED','REQUEST_COMPLETED') THEN attempt_id END),#{stage},#{outcome} FROM integration.if_request WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
INSERT INTO integration.if_attempt(id,request_key,attempt_number,status) VALUES(CAST(#{attempt} AS uuid),CAST(#{id} AS uuid),1,'SENDING')
mapper.update: UPDATE integration.if_attempt a SET status=r.status,http_status=r.http_status,error_code=r.error_code, completed_at=clock_timestamp(),duration_ms=greatest(0,floor(extract(epoch FROM (clock_timestamp()-a.started_at))*1000)::bigint) FROM integration.if_request r WHERE r.id=CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND a.id=r.attempt_id AND a.status='SENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT jsonb_build_object('request',jsonb_build_object('id',r.id,'requestId',r.request_id,'interfaceId',r.interface_id, 'traceId',r.trace_id,'status',r.status,'simulationId',r.simulation_id,'durationMs',r.duration_ms,'originalPayload',r.original_payload,'mappedPayload',r.mapped_payload, 'response',r.response_payload,'errors',r.validation_errors,'processingStage',r.processing_stage), 'events',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e) ORDER BY e.id) FROM integration.if_trace_event e WHERE e.request_key=r.id),'[]'::jsonb), 'attempts',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) ORDER BY a.attempt_number) FROM integration.if_attempt a WHERE a.request_key=r.id),'[]'::jsonb))::text FROM integration.if_request r WHERE r.trace_id=#{traceId} ORDER BY r.created_at,r.id LIMIT 101

WITH filtered AS (SELECT * FROM integration.if_request WHERE ) SELECT jsonb_build_object('total',count(*),'success',count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='SUCCESS'), 'failed',count(*) FILTER(WHERE status IN ('FAILED','VALIDATION_FAILED','MAPPING_FAILED')), 'unknown',count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='UNKNOWN'), 'inProgress',count(*) FILTER(WHERE status IN ('VALIDATING','READY','SENDING')), 'averageDurationMs',avg(duration_ms) FILTER(WHERE status IN ('SUCCESS','FAILED','UNKNOWN','VALIDATION_FAILED','MAPPING_FAILED')), 'recentErrors',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e)) FROM (SELECT id,request_id,interface_id,status,error_code,created_at FROM filtered WHERE error_code IS NOT NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 10) e),'[]'::jsonb), 'interfaces',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(i) ORDER BY i.interface_id,i.status) FROM (SELECT interface_id,status,count(*) AS count FROM filtered GROUP BY interface_id,status) i),'[]'::jsonb))::text FROM filtered

SELECT jsonb_build_object('hour',date_trunc('hour',created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'),'status',status,'count',count(*))::text FROM integration.if_request WHERE GROUP BY date_trunc('hour',created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'),status ORDER BY date_trunc('hour',created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'),status
